verdict.line: You win by poking from behind W (Hallowed Mist) and punishing his long R cooldown; you lose if he lands All Out and knocks you through a wall while your Flash is down.

brief.thesis: Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) means K'Sante can only threaten her if he physically walks into the mist, which turns his short-cooldown Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke into a losing proposition for him. Her passive and Q deal bonus magic/true damage scaled off target health, so his tank itemization does not blunt her damage the way it does against most top laners. The only real threat is his R (All Out, 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown), which can knock her through a wall and force a fight in his buffed, low-defense state.

theirWindow.when: he hits 2 Q stacks while you're in range
theirWindow.what: At 2 stacks his Q fires a shockwave that pulls you in, opening the combo into W (Path Maker) stun. Back off to reset his stacks before he reaches two, and never stand still in his Q line near a wall he could later R you into.

yourWindow.when: his R (All Out) is down after a whiff
yourWindow.what: It's an 80-120s cooldown ability, so once he burns or misses it he has no way to force you out of Hallowed Mist. Sit on the mist edge and chip him with Q and auto-attacks for the rest of that cooldown.

powerCurve.note: Neither has the tools to force anything yet
W lets you poke risk-free from range
All Out can knock you through walls
Passive %health damage outpaces his tank stacking
Teamfight R engage threatens your positioning

start.why: The sustain and early damage let you punish any Q trade he tries before you have W online at full effect.

boots.why: His Q autos and empowered All Out attacks are physical damage; the flat reduction blunts his poke and his ultimate's damage window.

core.why: Attack speed and cooldown reduction let you loop E (Skip 'n Slash) and Q (Snip Snip!) more often, maximizing passive procs.
Magic penetration and omnivamp keep your %health damage relevant as he builds resistances.
Bonus damage to low-health targets rewards the exact whittling pattern your passive and Q create.

situational.when: you keep getting caught by his All Out knockback and need to survive the follow-up dash
his lifesteal/healing from All Out is keeping him in fights too long
you're the primary target of his R engage in teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the poke pattern this lane wants: land Q or an auto from behind W's mist edge before he can close the gap.

summoners.why: Flash is your answer to being caught by All Out's knockback; Teleport keeps your wave and tempo advantage from the W poke phase relevant map-wide.

playing.title: Pre-cast W before he commits
playing.detail: Put up Hallowed Mist before he walks up to trade, since he can only target you once he's inside it — this baits him into a bad entry or denies the trade entirely.

playing.title: Count his Q stacks
playing.detail: His Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit and pulls you in with a shockwave at 2 stacks. Reset the trade before he lands the second hit.

playing.title: Loop E for poke and reset
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's dash-in, attack-speed window, dash-out pattern refunds cooldown on hit, letting you re-engage faster than his Footwork can reposition him.

playing.title: Respect walls from level 6
playing.detail: All Out's knockback launches you through terrain within 250 range. Don't fight or push near walls once he has his ultimate up.

playing.title: Punish the post-R window
playing.detail: After he uses or whiffs All Out, its 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown means he has no all-in tool for a long stretch — freely poke and shove during this window.

playing.title: Let passive do the work vs his tank build
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts and Q both scale off target health, so keep autoattacking and snipping through trades even as he stacks resistances.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard Gwen build as of recent patches (Nashor's Tooth into Riftmaker into Shadowflame, Arcane Comet primary); verify names and stats in-client since they may have shifted since this data was compiled.
